content: Unoptimized hero/gallery images are the most common Core Web Vitals (LCP) failure for local service sites; mobile users bounce ~32% more as load time goes 1s to 3s. Missing width/height attributes on images causes layout shift (CLS). Fix: compress/resize images to display dimensions, use modern formats (WebP/AVIF) with fallback, set explicit width/height, lazy-load below-the-fold images.
